text: ほほー　こわいほど　かちまくりだね！

patterns.name: 〜ほど
patterns.explanation: ほど after a word says 'to the point that', showing how far something goes. こわいほど = 'so much that it's scary'.

patterns.name: 〜まくる
patterns.explanation: まくる stuck onto a verb says it is done again and again without holding back; まくり is its thing-like form used with だ. かちまくり = 'winning like crazy'.
